Get AI-GENIE Python Environment Info

Source: R/zzz.R
python_env_info.Rd

Returns diagnostic information about the AIGENIE Python environment, including paths, installation status, and installed packages. Useful for troubleshooting Python-related issues.

Usage

python_env_info()

Value

A list with the following elements:

env_path

Path to the virtual environment directory.

python_path

Path to the Python executable.

env_exists

Logical. Whether the environment directory exists.

python_exists

Logical. Whether the Python executable exists.

initialized

Logical. Whether Python has been initialized this session.

uv_available

Logical. Whether UV is installed and accessible.

installed_packages

Character vector of installed packages (if environment exists).

See also

reinstall_python_env to fix environment issues.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Check environment status
info <- python_env_info()

# Is the environment set up?
info$env_exists

# What packages are installed?
cat(info$installed_packages, sep = "\n")

# Is UV available?
info$uv_available
} # }
